_about: Placeholder contracts (Phase 2) using abstract items. Paul replaces these with the real progression. Fields: item (canonical id), amount, creditEach (credits per part delivered), unlock (machine ids added to the toolbar when this contract is done), milestone (true: the plot grows to the next stage in plot.json and the camera pulls out). Phase 3: cityPower (the city's power cap from this contract on; before any contract sets it, the city covers all demand), gift (free builds, for example {"solar": 2}), perks (fixed perk ids for this milestone's level-up card; otherwise smart offers), supplyDrop ({ item, amount } for the supply drop perk). Phase 4: rate ({ perMinute, minutes }) makes a standing order: keep that many parts per minute arriving for that long (no amount).
